short: For women who have spent years holding everyone else, Desiree Maultsby, MTP, offers a place to finally slow down. The nervous system regulation work blends qi gong, breathwork, guided visualization, and process art, grounded in more than two decades of somatic and expressive arts practice. Through Sacred Circle Institute, she leads women’s retreats, creative circles, and private sessions in Tucson and online.
certs: Certificate in Process Art, The Painting Experience (Stewart Cubley); Certificate in Somatic Embodiment and Regulation Strategies (Linda Thai, 12 weeks), Certified Holistic Sexuality Educator (Institute of Sexuality Education and Enlightenment.
training: Master's in Transpersonal Psychology, Sofia University (formerly Institute of Transpersonal Psychology); massage therapy training and Arizona licensure; Clinical Trauma Specialist training; former Spiritual Wellness Practitioner, Canyon Ranch Tucson

long:
I’m Desiree Maultsby, a Brooklyn-born, Tucson-based facilitator with more than twenty years in somatic practice, ceremonial work, and expressive arts. Through Sacred Circle Institute, I help women come home to their bodies and reclaim their creative wisdom. My sessions weave qi gong, breathwork, guided visualization, and process art (painting, mixed media, writing, and movement) into a practice of presence rather than performance. No art experience is needed.

My work follows the PARC Process: Land, Listen, Make, Honor, Return. Together we slow down, settle the body, follow what wants to be made, and carry its wisdom back into daily life. I especially love working with women who have spent years holding everyone else and are ready to claim their own voice.

Offerings include women’s retreats, private sessions, monthly online painting circles, group programs, and facilitation for organizations and communities.
size: Desired size: Growing toward serving 300+ women by 2028 through circles, private work, and partnerships with aligned organizations.
